// ============================================================================

// ONI Custom Event Helper (emit) – minimal inline version

// This makes ONI.emit(eventName, payload) available if it isn't already.

// ============================================================================

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

// Default: LOCAL ONLY (perfect for UI-ish things like animationStart/End)

ONI.emit = function (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

// When you REALLY want to broadcast something across all clients

// (e.g. game-state changes, global cutscene flags), use this:

ONI.emitWorld = function (eventName, payload = {}) {

Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

if (!ONI._worldRx) {

ONI._worldRx = (data) => {

if (!data?.action) return;

Hooks.callAll(data.action, data.payload);

};

game.socket.on("world", ONI._worldRx);

}

console.log("[ONI Events] Helper installed.");

}

/**

* JRPG Lightning Breath Spell – Foundry VTT v12 + Sequencer + JB2A

* (wired to your system via oni:animationStart / oni:animationEnd events)

*

* - Source: selected token

* - Targets: ALL Foundry targets (multi-target supported)

* - Uses your spell cutscene template:

* dim screen, hide name/bars, fade out others, soft-pan to caster, play beams+impacts, pan back, restore

* - Emits oni:animationStart / oni:animationEnd (LOCAL ONLY) using ONI.emit

*/

(async () => {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

return ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

}

const sourceToken = canvas.tokens.controlled[0];

const targets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

if (!sourceToken) return ui.notifications.warn("Select a token first.");

if (!targets.length) return ui.notifications.warn("Target at least 1 token first (use Foundry's targeting system).");

// --- DEBUG: macro start --------------------------------------------------

console.log(

"[ONI LightningBreath] START",

"source:", sourceToken.name, `(${sourceToken.id})`,

"targets:", targets.map(t => `${t.name}(${t.id})`).join(", "),

"time:", new Date().toISOString()

);

// --- Broadcast: Animation START (LOCAL ONLY) ----------------------------

ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", {

type: "spellLightningBreath",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: targets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

// --- Tunables -----------------------------------------------------------

const fadeDuration = 400; // ms for token fade in/out

const dimAlpha = 0.6; // opacity for the screen dim

const dimFadeDuration = 300; // ms for dimmer fade in/out

const panDuration = 600; // ms to pan toward caster

const panBackDuration = 600; // ms to pan back

const spellDelay = 300; // ms before VFX after pan finishes

const impactDelay = 500; // ms after spell start to play impact

// Impact tint only (beam has NO tint)

const impactPurpleTint = "#E36BFF";

// Origin offset (your preferred values)

const lightningOriginOffsetX = 350; // world +X

const lightningOriginOffsetY = 150; // world +Y

// Scales

const spellScale = 1.25;

const impactScale = 0.55;

// Assets

const dimImageFile = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/ScreenDimmer.png";

const castSoundFile = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Cast1.ogg";

const breathSoundFile = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Laser2.ogg";

const impactSoundFile = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Thunder8.ogg";

const spellVfxFile =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Template/Line/Breath_Weapon/BreathWeapon_Lightning01_Regular_Blue_30ft_Line_Burst_1200x200.webm";

const impactVfxFile =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Impact/Impact_12_Regular_Blue_400x400.webm";

// --- Helper: get active combat tokens (fallback: all placeables) --------

const activeCombat = game.combats?.active;

let combatTokens = [];

if (activeCombat) {

for (const c of activeCombat.combatants) {

const tok = canvas.tokens.get(c.tokenId);

if (tok) combatTokens.push(tok);

}

} else {

combatTokens = canvas.tokens.placeables.slice();

}

// Everyone except source & ALL targets will be faded out

const keepIds = new Set([sourceToken.id, ...targets.map(t => t.id)]);

const others = combatTokens.filter(t => !keepIds.has(t.id));

// Store original opacity so we can restore it

const originalOpacity = new Map();

for (const t of others) originalOpacity.set(t.id, t.alpha ?? 1);

// --- Store & hide token nameplates + resource bars for ALL combat tokens -

const tokenDisplaySettings = new Map();

for (const t of combatTokens) {

const doc = t.document;

tokenDisplaySettings.set(t.id, {

displayName: doc.displayName,

displayBars: doc.displayBars

});

}

if (combatTokens.length > 0) {

const hideUpdates = combatTokens.map(t => ({

_id: t.id,

displayName: CONST.TOKEN_DISPLAY_MODES.NONE,

displayBars: CONST.TOKEN_DISPLAY_MODES.NONE

}));

await canvas.scene.updateEmbeddedDocuments("Token", hideUpdates);

}

// --- Start screen dimmer as a Sequencer effect BELOW tokens -------------

new Sequence()

.effect(dimImageFile)

.atLocation(sourceToken)

.scale(40)

.belowTokens()

.opacity(dimAlpha)

.persist()

.name("oni-spell-dimmer")

.fadeIn(dimFadeDuration)

.fadeOut(dimFadeDuration)

.play();

// --- Fade out everyone except source & targets --------------------------

if (others.length > 0) {

const fadeOutSeq = new Sequence();

for (const t of others) {

fadeOutSeq.animation().on(t).opacity(0).duration(fadeDuration);

}

await fadeOutSeq.play();

}

// --- Store original view (to pan back with Sequencer later) -------------

const originalView = canvas.getViewPosition

? canvas.getViewPosition()

: {

x: canvas.stage.pivot.x,

y: canvas.stage.pivot.y,

scale: canvas.stage.scale.x

};

// Soft pan toward source

const sourceCenter = sourceToken.center;

const panFactor = 0.35;

const panTarget = {

x: originalView.x + (sourceCenter.x - originalView.x) * panFactor,

y: originalView.y + (sourceCenter.y - originalView.y) * panFactor

};

// Origin point with your offset

const originPoint = {

x: sourceToken.center.x + lightningOriginOffsetX,

y: sourceToken.center.y + lightningOriginOffsetY

};

// --- DEBUG: before main Sequence ----------------------------------------

console.log(

"[ONI LightningBreath] Playing main Sequence",

"spellVfxFile:", spellVfxFile,

"impactVfxFile:", impactVfxFile,

"originPoint:", originPoint,

"impactDelay:", impactDelay,

"time:", new Date().toISOString()

);

// --- Main sequence: pan in -> spell -> impacts -> pan back --------------

const seq = new Sequence();

// 1) Pan slightly toward source

seq.canvasPan()

.atLocation(panTarget)

.duration(panDuration)

.scale(originalView.scale)

.waitUntilFinished();

if (spellDelay > 0) seq.wait(spellDelay);

// 2) Spell sounds

seq.sound()

.file(castSoundFile)

.volume(0.9);

seq.sound()

.file(breathSoundFile)

.volume(0.9)

.delay(3000);

// 3) Lightning breath beam for EACH target (NO TINT on beam)

// Add all beams; only the last one waits so they overlap instead of serializing.

targets.forEach((t, i) => {

const isLast = i === targets.length - 1;

const e = seq.effect()

.file(spellVfxFile)

.atLocation(originPoint)

.rotateTowards(t)

.scale(spellScale);

if (isLast) e.waitUntilFinished(0.5);

});

// 4) Impact sound ONCE + Impact VFX for EACH target (impact stays tinted purple)

seq.sound()

.file(impactSoundFile)

.delay(impactDelay)

.volume(0.9);

for (const t of targets) {

seq.effect()

.file(impactVfxFile)

.atLocation(t)

.delay(impactDelay)

.tint(impactPurpleTint)

.scale(impactScale);

}

// 5) Pan back

seq.canvasPan()

.atLocation({ x: originalView.x, y: originalView.y })

.duration(panBackDuration)

.scale(originalView.scale)

.waitUntilFinished();

await seq.play();

// --- DEBUG: after main Sequence completes -------------------------------

console.log(

"[ONI LightningBreath] Main Sequence complete for",

sourceToken.name, "->", targets.map(t => t.name).join(", "),

"time:", new Date().toISOString()

);

// --- Fade everyone back in ----------------------------------------------

if (others.length > 0) {

const fadeInSeq = new Sequence();

for (const t of others) {

fadeInSeq.animation()

.on(t)

.opacity(originalOpacity.get(t.id) ?? 1)

.duration(fadeDuration);

}

await fadeInSeq.play();

}

// --- Restore token nameplates + resource bars ---------------------------

if (tokenDisplaySettings.size > 0) {

const restoreUpdates = [];

for (const t of combatTokens) {

const saved = tokenDisplaySettings.get(t.id);

if (!saved) continue;

restoreUpdates.push({

_id: t.id,

displayName: saved.displayName,

displayBars: saved.displayBars

});

}

if (restoreUpdates.length > 0) {

await canvas.scene.updateEmbeddedDocuments("Token", restoreUpdates);

}

}

// --- End the dimmer effect so it fades out nicely ------------------------

if (globalThis.Sequencer?.EffectManager) {

Sequencer.EffectManager.endEffects({ name: "oni-spell-dimmer" });

}

// --- Broadcast: Animation END (LOCAL ONLY) -------------------------------

ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {

type: "spellLightningBreath",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: targets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

// --- DEBUG: macro end ----------------------------------------------------

console.log(

"[ONI LightningBreath] END",

"source:", sourceToken.name,

"time:", new Date().toISOString()

);

})();

// The Zero Power sky is a CURTAIN, not a dim. It hides the board, so it sits

// host 5 caster clone 10 black 20 sky 30 bolts

// 35 curtain dim 40 cut-in 45 charge 50 breath

// above 80 caster clone (after teardown) 90 whiteout 95 silhouettes

const above = oni.layer({ zIndex: 99000 });

above.sortableChildren = true;

// caster are still on screen after the curtain is destroyed.

const pins = [];

const pinsTop = [];

for (const p of pins) { try { p(); } catch (e) {} }

for (const p of pinsTop) { try { p(); } catch (e) {} }

};

PIXI.Ticker.shared.add(repin);

g.anchor.set(0.5); g.tint = color; g.alpha = 0; g.zIndex = z;

(layer || host).addChild(g);

if (!g || g.destroyed) return;

const c = S.S2W(0.5, 0.5);

g.position.set(c.x, c.y);

async function imageSprite(url, z) {

/* ── P00 Zero Power cut-in ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

// The house pattern, matching Rauben's Night of Hundred Bandits: dim, the

// comes from the ACTOR -- system.props.cut_in_zero_power, falling back to

// her sheet art -- so the sheet owns it and this script does not have to.

const zpUrl = (function () {

try {

const ac = caster && caster.actor ? caster.actor : null;

if (!ac) return '';

return foundry.utils.getProperty(ac, 'system.props.cut_in_zero_power') || ac.img || '';

} catch (e) { return ''; }

})();

if (zpUrl) {

const zpDim = plate(0x000000, 88, above, true);

await oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.zpDimMs, ease: E.outQuad,

onUpdate: (v) => { zpDim.alpha = v * cfg.zpDimTo; } });

playSfx('sfxZeroCutin', 'sfxZeroCutinVol');

// 0 = off the left edge, 1 = seated, 2 = gone off the right.

let zpSpr = null;

try {

const ztex = await loadTexture(zpUrl);

if (ztex) {

zpSpr.anchor.set(0, 1); // bottom-left, so it stands on the seat line

zpSpr.zIndex = 92;

above.addChild(zpSpr);

pinsTop.push(function () {

if (!zpSpr || zpSpr.destroyed) return;

// FIT inside a box, do not scale by height alone. Rauben's cut-in is a

const maxW = S.wLen(S.W) * cfg.zpPortraitW;

maxW / Math.max(1, ztex.orig.width)));

} catch (e) { console.warn(TAG, 'cut-in portrait failed', zpUrl); }

onUpdate: (v) => { zpT = v; } });

await wait(cfg.zpHoldMs);

await oni.tween({ from: 1, to: 2, duration: cfg.zpOutMs, ease: E.inOutCubic,

onUpdate: (v) => { zpT = v; } });

try { if (zpSpr) zpSpr.destroy(); } catch (e) {}

await oni.tween({ from: 1, to: 0, duration: cfg.zpDimOutMs, ease: E.inOutQuad,

onUpdate: (v) => { zpDim.alpha = v * cfg.zpDimTo; } });

try { zpDim.destroy(); } catch (e) {}

}

const baseSY = clone ? clone.scale.y : 1;

await oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.riseMs, ease: E.inQuad, onUpdate: (v) => {

} });

await oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.blackMs, ease: E.inOutQuad,

onUpdate: (v) => { black.alpha = v; } });

// She is NOT handed back here. The clone moves up to the surviving layer and

await wait(cfg.blackHoldMs);

let skyDrop = 0;

const sky = await imageSprite(A.skyImg, 20);

if (sky) {

const ta = (sky.texture.orig.width || 1) / (sky.texture.orig.height || 1);

pins.push(function () {

// COVER, not contain: the plate must never show a letterbox edge. The art

const va = S.W / S.H;

let w, h;

if (ta > va) { h = S.wLen(S.H); w = h * ta; } else { w = S.wLen(S.W); h = w / ta; }

playSfx('sfxSky', 'sfxSkyVol');

// alpha ramp finished while the plate was still moving.

await Promise.all([

oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.skySlideMs, ease: E.outQuad,

onUpdate: (v) => { skyDrop = v; } }),

oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.skyFadeMs, ease: E.inOutQuad,

onUpdate: (v) => { if (sky) sky.alpha = v; } }),

/* ── P05 Hold on the settled sky ─────────────────────────────────────── */

// No strikes here any more. They fought the charge cue that follows: two

// rumbles inside four seconds read as noise rather than as weather.

await wait(cfg.skyHoldMs);

/* ── P06 Dim the curtain ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

const curtainDim = plate(0x000000, 35);

await oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.curtainDimMs, ease: E.inOutQuad,

onUpdate: (v) => { curtainDim.alpha = v * cfg.curtainDimTo; } });

/* ── P07 Cut-in slides up from the bottom ────────────────────────────── */

let cutinRise = 0;

// ONE driver for her pull-back: 0 at the jaw, 1 fully withdrawn. She starts

// going the moment the breath fires instead of waiting for the dolly beat,

// so the recoil and the travel are the same motion.

let retreat = 0;

const cutin = await imageSprite(A.cutinImg, 40);

if (cutin) {

const ta = (cutin.texture.orig.width || 1) / (cutin.texture.orig.height || 1);

pins.push(function () {

const h = S.wLen(S.H) * cfg.cutinH * (1 - retreat * (1 - cfg.dollyCutinScale));

cutin.height = h; cutin.width = h * ta;

const yFrom = cfg.cutinY + cfg.cutinFromFrac;

const fx = cfg.cutinX - retreat * cfg.dollyDriftX;

const fy = (yFrom + (cfg.cutinY - yFrom) * cutinRise) - retreat * cfg.dollyDriftY;

playSfx('sfxCutin', 'sfxCutinVol');

await oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.cutinInMs, ease: E.outQuad, onUpdate: (v) => {

cutinRise = v; if (cutin) cutin.alpha = Math.min(1, v * 1.6);

} });

await wait(cfg.cutinHoldMs);

/* ── P08 Charging ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

// The mouth is a fraction of the CUT-IN, not of the screen, so the glow and

// the breath origin follow the art through the slide and the dolly. These

// numbers were measured off a live frame: the glow at the centre of the

// illustration is PAINTED IN, and aiming at it fired from her shoulder.

function mouthPoint() {

if (!cutin) return S.S2W(0.5, 0.4);

return { x: cutin.x + (cfg.mouthX - 0.5) * cutin.width,

y: cutin.y + (cfg.mouthY - 0.5) * cutin.height };

charge.anchor.set(0.5); charge.tint = cfg.coreColor; charge.alpha = 0;

charge.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; charge.zIndex = 45;

host.addChild(charge);

let chargeK = 0;

let chargeJit = 0;

pins.push(function () {

const m = mouthPoint();

charge.position.set(m.x + chargeJit * (Math.random() * 2 - 1), m.y + chargeJit * (Math.random() * 2 - 1));

});

playSfx('sfxCharge', 'sfxChargeVol');

await oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.chargeMs, ease: E.inQuad, onUpdate: (v) => {

chargeK = 0.2 + v * 0.8;

chargeJit = S.wLen(S.H * cfg.chargeShake) * v;

charge.alpha = Math.min(1, v * 1.4);

} });

// Hold at full charge. The pause before it fires is most of what makes a

// Zero Power feel like one.

await wait(cfg.chargeHoldMs);

/* ── P09 Unleash ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

let beamGain = 0;

let ballT = 0;

let ballSpr = null;

// Lightning arcs, re-rolled on a timer rather than every frame: at 60fps the

// field churns too fast to read as lightning and just shimmers.

let arcs = [];

let lastArc = 0;

function rollArcs() {

arcs = [];

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.arcCount; i++) {

const t0 = Math.random() * 0.85;

const span = 0.10 + Math.random() * 0.45;

const steps = 4 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 5);

const pts = [];

for (let k = 0; k <= steps; k++) {

pts.push({ t: Math.min(1, t0 + span * (k / steps)), j: Math.random() * 2 - 1 });

}

// Some arcs deliberately overhang the beam edge -- in the reference the

// bolts stick OUT of the body rather than being contained by it. Each

// carries its OWN opacity and girth: a field drawn at one alpha reads as

// a printed pattern rather than as live electricity.

arcs.push({ pts, over: Math.random() < cfg.arcOverhangChance,

alpha: cfg.arcAlphaMin + Math.random() * (cfg.arcAlphaMax - cfg.arcAlphaMin),

w: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.35 });

}

}

function drawBreath(g, m, ux, uy, len, w0, w1, shimmer) {

const nx = -uy, ny = ux;

const now = performance.now();

// The body is a SEGMENTED band, not one quad: a four-point wedge has

// nothing to animate along its length, so its edge could never shimmer

// while the beam is held.

const edgeW = function (k, side) {

const t = k / cfg.edgeSteps;

const base = w0 + (w1 - w0) * t;

if (!shimmer) return { t: t, w: base };

const ph = k * 1.7 + side * 2.1 + now / 1000 * cfg.shimmerHz * Math.PI * 2;

return { t: t, w: base * (1 + Math.sin(ph) * cfg.shimmerDepth) };

};

const band = function (color, scale, alpha) {

g.beginFill(color, alpha);

for (let k = 0; k <= cfg.edgeSteps; k++) {

const e = edgeW(k, 1); const d = len * e.t; const w = e.w * scale;

const x = m.x + ux * d + nx * w, y = m.y + uy * d + ny * w;

if (k === 0) { g.moveTo(x, y); } else { g.lineTo(x, y); }

}

for (let k = cfg.edgeSteps; k >= 0; k--) {

const e = edgeW(k, -1); const d = len * e.t; const w = e.w * scale;

g.lineTo(m.x + ux * d - nx * w, m.y + uy * d - ny * w);

}

g.closePath(); g.endFill();

};

band(cfg.color, 1, 0.55);

band(cfg.coreColor, 0.45, 0.95);

// Arcs are FILLED tapered slivers, not stroked polylines. A constant-width

// stroke with round caps read as soft noodles laid over the beam; these

// come to a point, have hard mitred edges, and each carries its own alpha.

if (now - lastArc > cfg.arcChurnMs) { lastArc = now; rollArcs(); }

const aw = S.wLen(S.H * cfg.arcWidth);

for (const a of arcs) {

const n = a.pts.length;

if (n < 2) continue;

const pos = [];

for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {

const p = a.pts[k];

const d = len * p.t;

const half = (w0 + (w1 - w0) * p.t) * (a.over ? cfg.arcOverhang : 0.8);

pos.push({ x: m.x + ux * d + nx * p.j * half, y: m.y + uy * d + ny * p.j * half,

w: aw * a.w * Math.pow(1 - k / (n - 1), cfg.arcTaper) });

}

// Offset along the LOCAL segment normal, not the beam normal. Offsetting

// a zig-zagging centreline by a fixed direction makes the ribbon cross

// itself, and PIXI fills the crossing as a hollow angular blob.

const pn = [];

for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {

const q0 = pos[Math.max(0, k - 1)], q1 = pos[Math.min(n - 1, k + 1)];

let dx = q1.x - q0.x, dy = q1.y - q0.y;

const dl = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;

pn.push({ x: -dy / dl, y: dx / dl });

}

g.beginFill(cfg.coreColor, a.alpha);

g.moveTo(pos[0].x + pn[0].x * pos[0].w, pos[0].y + pn[0].y * pos[0].w);

for (let k = 1; k < n; k++) { g.lineTo(pos[k].x + pn[k].x * pos[k].w, pos[k].y + pn[k].y * pos[k].w); }

for (let k = n - 1; k >= 0; k--) { g.lineTo(pos[k].x - pn[k].x * pos[k].w, pos[k].y - pn[k].y * pos[k].w); }

g.closePath(); g.endFill();

}

}

const breath = new PIXI.Graphics();

breath.zIndex = 50; breath.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

host.addChild(breath);

if (cfg.breathMode === 'ball') {

const m0 = mouthPoint();

const ball = await oni.webm(A.ballWebm, { size: S.wLen(S.H * cfg.ballSize),

blend: PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD, alpha: 0 });

ballSpr.position.set(m.x + Math.cos(cfg.beamAngle) * reach,

await oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.beamOutMs, ease: E.outQuad, onUpdate: (v) => {

beamGain = v; ballT = v * 0.25;

retreat = v * cfg.retreatOnFire;

charge.alpha = 1 - v * 0.6;

} });

pins.length = 0;

const dim = await oni.sceneDim({ to: cfg.targetDimTo, fadeIn: cfg.targetDimMs });

strike.sortableChildren = true;

hit.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; hit.zIndex = 5;

strike.addChild(hit);

const cen = victims.reduce((a, v) => { const c = ctr(v); return { x: a.x + c.x / victims.length, y: a.y + c.y / victims.length }; }, { x: 0, y: 0 });

const drawHit = function () {

// ONE bolt across the whole frame rather than a lane per enemy. Per-enemy

// lanes read as several small hits; this is one blow that happens to

try { if (clone) clone.destroy(); } catch (e) {}

try { PIXI.Ticker.shared.remove(repin); } catch (e) {}

try { above.destroy({ children: true }); } catch (e) {}

} });

scriptSource,

try { spr.destroy(); } catch (e) {}

}

function streak(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width, host) {

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.lineStyle({ width: width, color: color, alpha: 1, cap: 'round' });

g.moveTo(x1, y1); g.lineTo(x2, y2);

g.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

(host || canvas.stage).addChild(g);

return g;

}

if (!caster || !prime) { done(); return; }

const host = oni.layer({ zIndex: 95500 });

const t = ctr(prime);

const dim = await oni.sceneDim({ to: cfg.dimTo, fadeIn: cfg.dimMs });

// Clear the stage of everyone who is not part of this. Their mesh alpha is

// re-asserted every tick because Foundry refreshes tokens on its own

// schedule and would otherwise fade them straight back in mid-shot.

const keep = new Set([caster.id].concat(tgts.map(function (x) { return x.id; })));

const bystanders = (canvas.tokens.placeables || []).filter(function (x) { return x && !keep.has(x.id); });

const bystanderAlpha = new Map();

for (const b of bystanders) { bystanderAlpha.set(b.id, (b.mesh && b.mesh.alpha != null) ? b.mesh.alpha : 1); }

let bystanderHold = 1;

const holdBystanders = function () {

for (const b of bystanders) { if (b && b.mesh && !b.destroyed) b.mesh.alpha = bystanderHold; }

};

PIXI.Ticker.shared.add(holdBystanders);

const restoreBystanders = function () {

try { PIXI.Ticker.shared.remove(holdBystanders); } catch (e) {}

for (const b of bystanders) {

if (!b || b.destroyed) continue;

const a = bystanderAlpha.has(b.id) ? bystanderAlpha.get(b.id) : 1;

try { if (b.mesh) b.mesh.alpha = a; } catch (e) {}

try { b.renderFlags.set({ refreshVisibility: true, refreshMesh: true }); } catch (e) {}

}

};

await Promise.all([

oni.camera.focus({ point: t, zoom: cfg.camZoom, duration: cfg.camInMs }),

oni.tween({ from: 1, to: cfg.bystanderTo, duration: cfg.bystanderFadeMs, ease: E.inOutQuad,

onUpdate: function (v) { bystanderHold = v; } }),

]);

playSfx('sfxCast', 'sfxCastVol');

// Hauled off the ground. The real token is hidden and a clone is flown, so

// nothing fights Foundry's own placeable refresh.

const vicHalfH = (prime.mesh && prime.mesh.height ? prime.mesh.height : (prime.h || 100)) * 0.5;

const lifted = { x: t.x, y: t.y - vicHalfH * cfg.liftFrac };

const vic = oni.cloneToken(prime, { parent: host });

const restoreVictim = oni.hideToken(prime);

await oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.liftMs, ease: E.outQuad, onUpdate: function (v) {

if (vic) vic.position.set(t.x, t.y + (lifted.y - t.y) * v);

} });

// Needles that have landed live in this rig, positioned RELATIVE to the

// victim. Moving the rig with them is what lets them stay stuck in as the

// body moves, instead of hanging in the air where they hit.

const rig = new PIXI.Container();

rig.position.set(lifted.x, lifted.y);

host.addChild(rig);

// One shared offset driver: the victim and the rig read the same values, so

// anything pinned to them tracks exactly.

let joltX = 0, joltY = 0;

let struggling = true;

// Amplitude of the thrash, dialled to 0 once the needles start: a body that

// is already pinned should be HELD, and the only motion left is the kick

// each hit delivers. Leaving the tremor running underneath made the impacts

// unreadable, because everything was moving all the time.

let ampNow = cfg.struggleAmp;

const struggle = function () {

if (!struggling) return;

const amp = S.wLen(ampNow);

const ox = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * amp + joltX;

const oy = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * amp * 0.6 + joltY;

if (vic && !vic.destroyed) {

vic.position.set(lifted.x + ox, lifted.y + oy);

vic.rotation = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.03 * (ampNow / (cfg.struggleAmp || 1));

}

if (rig && !rig.destroyed) rig.position.set(lifted.x + ox, lifted.y + oy);

};

PIXI.Ticker.shared.add(struggle);

// Let the struggling read on its own before anything hits them.

await wait(cfg.struggleHoldMs);

// Hold still from here. The struggle was for the helplessness BEFORE the

// sentence; from the first needle they are pinned.

const settleFrom = ampNow;

await oni.tween({ from: 1, to: 0, duration: cfg.struggleSettleMs, ease: E.outQuad,

onUpdate: function (v) { ampNow = settleFrom * v; } });

ampNow = 0;

// Needles thrown from the EDGES of the frame. Screen anchors, so they come

// from off-frame whatever the camera is doing.

const anchors = [

S.S2W(0, 0), S.S2W(1, 0), S.S2W(0, 1), S.S2W(1, 1),

S.S2W(0.5, 0), S.S2W(0, 0.5), S.S2W(1, 0.5), S.S2W(0.5, 1),

];

// A needle: a long tapered spike, wide at the tail and sharp at the point.

// Drawn as a polygon rather than a capped line, because a round cap gives a

// blunt dowel and this has to read as something that PIERCES.

function needle(len, w, color, alpha) {

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.beginFill(color, alpha);

g.moveTo(0, 0);

g.lineTo(-len * 0.82, -w * 0.5);

g.lineTo(-len, 0);

g.lineTo(-len * 0.82, w * 0.5);

g.closePath();

g.endFill();

g.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

return g;

}

const pinned = [];

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.spearCount; i++) {

const from = anchors[i % anchors.length];

const ang = Math.atan2(lifted.y - from.y, lifted.x - from.x);

const reach = S.hPx(cfg.spearLenFrac);

// Where on the body it lands — scattered, not all through one point.

const spread = S.wLen(cfg.struggleAmp) * 3.2;

const lx = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread;

const ly = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread * 0.8;

const spike = needle(reach, S.wLen(cfg.spearWidth), cfg.color, 0.95);

const core = needle(reach * 0.9, S.wLen(cfg.spearWidth) * 0.38, cfg.coreColor, 1);

spike.rotation = ang; core.rotation = ang;

const flightFrom = { x: from.x - lifted.x, y: from.y - lifted.y };

spike.position.set(flightFrom.x, flightFrom.y);

core.position.set(flightFrom.x, flightFrom.y);

rig.addChild(spike, core);

await oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.spearFlightMs, ease: E.inQuad, onUpdate: function (v) {

const px = flightFrom.x + (lx - flightFrom.x) * v;

const py = flightFrom.y + (ly - flightFrom.y) * v;

spike.position.set(px, py); core.position.set(px, py);

} });

playSfx('sfxStab', 'sfxStabVol');

// Impact spray at the point of entry, in WORLD space so it does not ride

// the body afterwards.

oni.particles({ x: rig.position.x + lx, y: rig.position.y + ly,

count: cfg.spearHitParticles, color: cfg.coreColor, size: 11,

radius: S.wLen(cfg.spearHitRadius), life: 620, blend: PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD, parent: host });

// The hit knocks them: a decaying kick along the needle's own line.

const kick = S.wLen(cfg.spearJolt);

oni.tween({ from: 1, to: 0, duration: cfg.spearGapMs * 1.4, ease: E.outQuad, onUpdate: function (v) {

joltX = Math.cos(ang) * kick * v; joltY = Math.sin(ang) * kick * v;

} });

// They STAY IN. Nothing fades here — they all go at the detonation.

pinned.push(spike, core);

await wait(cfg.spearGapMs);

}

await wait(cfg.pinnedHoldMs);

joltX = 0; joltY = 0;

// ── Detonation: every needle goes off at once ──

playSfx('sfxBoom', 'sfxBoomVol');

if (cfg.boomWebm) fxWebm(cfg.boomWebm, rig.position.x, rig.position.y, { size: S.hPx(cfg.boomSize), parent: host, z: 96000 });

oni.particles({ x: rig.position.x, y: rig.position.y, count: cfg.burstParticles,

color: cfg.color, size: 15, radius: S.wLen(cfg.burstRadius), life: 950,

blend: PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD, parent: host });

oni.screenshake({ duration: cfg.shakeMs, intensity: 11 });

// The needles blow outward as they go, rather than simply vanishing.

const blowing = oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.detonateMs, ease: E.outQuad, onUpdate: function (v) {

for (const s of pinned) {

if (!s || s.destroyed) continue;

s.alpha = 1 - v;

s.scale.set(1 + v * 0.6);

}

} });

const flashing = oni.domFlash({ color: cfg.flashColor, alpha: cfg.flashAlpha,

fadeIn: cfg.flashInMs, hold: 90, fadeOut: cfg.flashOutMs, onPeak: function () { done(); } });

await Promise.all([blowing, flashing]);

for (const s of pinned) { try { s.destroy(); } catch (e) {} }

// DROPPED. Nothing is holding them up any more and they fall hard.

struggling = false;

try { PIXI.Ticker.shared.remove(struggle); } catch (e) {}

const fallFrom = { x: vic ? vic.position.x : lifted.x, y: vic ? vic.position.y : lifted.y };

await oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.dropMs, ease: E.inQuad, onUpdate: function (v) {

if (vic && !vic.destroyed) {

vic.position.set(fallFrom.x + (t.x - fallFrom.x) * v, fallFrom.y + (t.y - fallFrom.y) * v);

vic.rotation = 0.05 * v;

}

} });

// They hit the ground.

oni.screenshake({ duration: cfg.dropShakeMs, intensity: 9 });

await oni.tween({ from: 1, to: 0, duration: cfg.dropShakeMs, ease: E.outQuad, onUpdate: function (v) {

if (!vic || vic.destroyed) return;

const a = S.wLen(cfg.dropShakeAmp) * v;

vic.position.set(t.x + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * a, t.y + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * a * 0.5);

vic.rotation = 0.05 * v;

} });

if (vic && !vic.destroyed) { vic.position.set(t.x, t.y); vic.rotation = 0; }

restoreVictim();

try { if (vic) vic.destroy(); } catch (e) {}

try { rig.destroy({ children: true }); } catch (e) {}

await Promise.all([

oni.tween({ from: cfg.bystanderTo, to: 1, duration: cfg.camOutMs, ease: E.inOutQuad,

onUpdate: function (v) { bystanderHold = v; } }),

dim.fadeOut({ duration: cfg.camOutMs }),

oni.camera.restore({ duration: cfg.camOutMs }),

]);

restoreBystanders();

`;

try {

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 32000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS },

meta: { source: "Condemn" },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();
